name: print-on-stretched-tricot
description: Nylon-elastane tricot stretched 15 % both ways, then printed with 0.4 mm of TPU 95A and released. The fabric's stress-free state is 15 % shorter than the bonded one (prestrain -0.15), so the free sample curls with the fabric on the concave side: print-on-fabric shaping. Linear laminate theory at 15 % strain is itself an estimate.
